summary: Batch A, family A32 (the list-form polynomial chi-bound, stage 2 of the polynomial scope), on the A31 candidate 0449699 (stage 1, natural Horner evaluation), itself on the reviewed A30 candidate db16a76; neither parent is accepted main. X3's x3_polynomially_chi_bounded and X124's x124_poly_chi_bounded become transparent aliases.
